verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਅਸੁਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕੁਠਾਲੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ka(n)chan asudh jaise bhramat kuThaalee bikhai sudh bhe bhramat na paavak pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: As impure gold when heated in a crucible, keep on moving here and there but when purified becomes stable and glitters like fire.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kar ka(n)kan anek mai pragaT dhun ekai ek Tek pun dhun ko binaas hai ||

en.bdb: If many bangles are worn in one arm, they keep making noise by striking with each other but when melted and made into one become quiet and noiseless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਕੈ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khudhiaa kai baalak bilalaat akulaat at asathan paan kar sahaj nivaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a child cries when hungry but becomes quiet and peaceful after suckling milk from his mother's breasts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਧਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪਦ ਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise maiaa bhramat bhramat chatur ka(n)uT dhaavai gur upadhes nihachal gireh padh baas hai ||349||

en.bdb: Similarly a human mind engulfed in worldly attachments and love keeps on wandering all over. But by the sermons of the True Guru, he becomes stable and calm. (349)
